name: WindowsPackageLifecycleV1
build: run only from pinned release environment with Python 3.13 and 3.14 compatibility matrix already green
build frontend static assets with pinned Node toolchain in CI/build stage only; Node is not shipped/runtime-required
assemble Python host with PyInstaller 6.22.2 onedir x64 from hash-locked dependencies including verified SQLCipher binary
produce deterministic dependency/version manifest and scan bundle for forbidden customer/runtime/secret artifacts
wrap onedir application with Inno Setup 7.1.0 x64 per-user installer
release verification installs into clean supported Windows user profile and runs offline startup/login/backup/restore/browser/tray smoke tests
install: default non-elevated per-user install root under LocalAppData/Programs/SOMA Beta
create no firewall rule, Windows service, scheduled network task or system-wide credential
first launch resolves/creates separate LocalAppData/SOMA/Beta/instance-v1 data root with owner-appropriate ACL
tray uses Win32 Shell_NotifyIconW and controls verified launcher/start/stop/open operations
source deployment supplies explicit start/stop launchers using same trust protocol
upgrade: application binary upgrade never edits domain files directly
startup migration runner remains LLD-01 authority after SQLCipher security initialization
accepted migration files are immutable and exact release manifest is verified before authoritative startup
upgrade failure preserves data root and produces bounded sanitized diagnostics
uninstall: stop only the freshly verified SOMA run if one exists
remove application binaries/shortcuts/tray integration owned by installer
preserve instance root, database, DPAPI key envelopes, managed backups, diagnostics and operator-selected portable backups by default
Beta 1.0 uninstaller exposes no casual checkbox that silently destroys the data root; any future remove-data workflow requires separate explicit destructive contract and backup guidance
runtime: no CDN, pip, npm, winget, browser/runtime component or cryptographic dependency download
rules: package signing identity/hash freeze occurs at release candidate and is verification evidence, not domain authority
Windows/Edge/Chrome exact build matrix is re-recorded per release candidate
